notes: ⚠️ LAYOUT TYPE IS GONE FROM THE INTERFACE. Not hidden — removed. The row, its note, the Content Amount section that held them and every line that toggled them. It was being borrowed into Configure whether or not the panel's theme declared…

The seconds row no longer disappears when you pick a digital face — it disables. A row that appears and vanishes re-flows everything under it every time you choose a face, and it was taking the whole face gallery with it.

The clock face tiles stay where you left them. The gallery counted its own columns from the container's width, so anything that changed the pane by a few pixels — a row appearing, a scrollbar coming and going — re-wrapped it and every tile…
They are METERS, not progress bars. A progress bar reports how far through a task you are; these report a level that goes up and down. Renamed everywhere it is said to you.
